min_standing_note.value: Must have completed at least 2 full-time university semesters prior to exchange and be nominated by home institution.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Partner list row 25 lists University-wide UG scope (host college placement still subject to bilateral agreement coverage).

eligible_majors.notes: University-wide UG agreement in Excel (row 25); subject to Cornell college/school placement under the bilateral agreement.

min_gpa_host.notes: Minimum cumulative GPA 3.0 on 4.0 scale (to remain in good standing at Cornell, term GPA 2.0+ across >=12 credits is required).

english_course_availability.notes: Undergraduate instruction at Cornell University is in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT 100, IELTS Academic 7.5, or Duolingo English Test 130 (exempt for native speakers or applicants studying at an institution where English is the official language).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall: Instruction Aug 24 – Dec 4, 2026; Final Exams Dec 11–19, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring: Instruction Jan 25 – May 11, 2027; Final Exams May 15–22, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: Official page explicitly states: 'Exchange students do not pay Cornell tuition, but are responsible for charges billed through Cornell's Office of the Bursar system: Student Health Insurance, Student health fee, [and] Student activity fee.'

est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2026-2027 undergraduate living expenses estimated at $27,507 USD/year (prorated monthly = $2,292 USD/month over 12 months).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: $2,292 USD/month * 5 months * 1.0 = $11,460 USD (already in USD, 1 USD = 1.0 USD, checked 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Bursar charges: Cornell Student Health Plan (2026-2027: $4,092/year; Fall new $1,705; Spring new $2,046), Student Health Fee ($300/semester 2026-2027), and Student Activity Fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Student Health Fee ($300/semester 2026-2027) at https://health.cornell.edu/billing-insurance/student-health-fee; fee requirement on international-exchange page.

housing_availability.notes: On-campus housing is limited and not guaranteed for incoming exchange/visiting students; off-campus housing/sublet guidance provided.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing is limited and NOT guaranteed for incoming exchange students; if assigned on-campus housing or meal plan, fees appear on the Cornell Bursar bill.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Accepted international exchange students must submit Declaration of Finances and bank documentation for J-1/F-1 immigration processing (reference UG living expense budget $27,507/year).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Exact visa lead time in weeks not specified; see https://international.globallearning.cornell.edu/tuition-and-living-expenses.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours; full-time exchange students must complete a minimum of 12 credits per semester with a 2.0+ term GPA to maintain good academic standing.
credit_system_and_load.notes: 12-credit minimum for good academic standing verified on cornell.edu.

course_restrictions_note.value: Students are placed into an undergraduate Cornell college/school covered by the partner agreement based on proposed major; enrollment subject to prerequisites, class size, instructor consent, and college-specific restrictions (major-only capstones, first-year writing seminars, and independent study/lab research typically closed).

value: List of Cornell courses of interest
Official transcripts (undergraduate and graduate if applicable)
required_application_docs.notes: Plus Declaration of Finances / bank letter after acceptance for immigration documents.

academic_style.notes: US research university with credit-hour system and college-based undergraduate distribution.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination Mar 1 / Application Mar 15; Spring: Nomination Sep 1 / Application Sep 15.
